name: sales_aggregation

source.name: BigCodeBench
source.modifications: Reused the regional grouping and summation idea from BigCodeBench/741, expanded it into a multi-module sales reporting package with shared amount conversion, added refund records, filters, metrics and reports, and rewrote all tests.

issue: 调用 aggregate_sales 或 total_revenue 处理包含退款的销售记录时，退款被加到了区域收入中。例如 north 区域销售额为 100 元、退款为 30 元，期望净收入为 70 元，实际得到 130 元。请修复该问题，并保持纯销售记录、金额格式化、筛选和指标计算的行为不变。
notes: The refund branch adds the amount instead of subtracting it. The shared to_amount and normalize_records helpers are unchanged, and regression tests use sales-only records so they pass in both states.
